main_text.l: Regesuniversæterræ,& imprimis Austri Regina illa sagacissima ut priscis olim philosophis apodemicis usu venit) ad eum audiendum accessit. 3. Reg. 4. 10. Itaq; major propositio videtur planè ἀνένσατος.

Minor multis probatur argumentis. Nam ex sacris literis perspicuum fit, (contrà quàm chymici nonnulli hallucinantur) Salomoni divitiarum affluentiam tantam, non quidem ex chymia, sed ex innumeris provinciarum locupletissimarum tributis, exactionibus, vectigalibus, Regijs donationibus & largitionibus constitisse: maxime verò ex auro Ophir Tharsis advecto. Nam præ auri copia argentum viluit, cujus tantum, quantum olim esset lapidum, Hierosolymæ suppetebat. 3. Reg.

page.notes: The Greek word at the end of the first paragraph is printed in Greek letters; it is transcribed as best read. Ornamental border and faint show-through from the facing page are not transcribed. The printed text ends with the catchword-like abbreviation "Reg." set at the right.
